_comment: Template: Export the descriptions of an RDFS profile to Excel.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar rdfs-describe --config this-file.json
_note_rdfsFile: The RDFS profile (RDF/XML). Relative paths resolve against this file's folder.
_note_output: The .xlsx workbook to write: one row per class, property, enumeration value and package.
